I’m not sure if this is the right spot. But I think it is, since this is a design idea for a space ship.
Since CCP is located in iceland I wonder - why are there no Space vikings?!

I worked on a general design idea and refurbished it via ChatGPT.
The name is a suggestion from ChatGPT and supposedly means “iron blood” - I thought it to be quite fitting.

But i must say - I love it! Would be a banger to fly one of these!
I think it would be dope if the dragon head would have some sort of energy orb inside it’s maw.

posts.name: QuakeGod
posts.cooked:
Tian Farforge:

why are there no Space vikings

For the same reason there are no Space Conquistadors. Thousands of years have passed, and the world of EVE knows nothing of the Earth they left behind, so why would they know about Vikings?

posts.name: Gerard Amatin
posts.cooked:
They definitely know about Vikings, the Minmatar culture regularly names ships after old Norse mythology.

Loki, Huginn and Muninn, Naglfar just to name a few.

That said, I think a ship like that looks a bit out of place in a sci-fi universe like New Eden. Ships in EVE are like modern fighter jets, excavator machines or container ships, they’re built for a purpose.

A big dragon head doesn’t fit such a purpose.

However, many pilots in EVE express themselves with a good paint job and I think nice viking-inspired patterns could look great on ships as a skin or SKINR component.
